_comment: Native XRP. Underlying sentinel and bridgeTokenId verified live against XRPL EVM mainnet (chain 1440000) and Axelar's axelar-contract-deployments mainnet.json. Same pattern already proven live on testnet (sXRP).
USDC (Axelar-wrapped). Address and decimals (6) re-verified live via eth_call on 2026-09-10. bridgeTokenId read directly from the token's own interchainTokenId() on-chain, not guessed.

mXRP (Midas). Collateral only, borrowCap=0 by design (circular-leverage guard, per risk doc). The token itself doesn't expose interchainTokenId() directly (unlike USDC/USDT/WETH/WBTC) because it's bridged as a LOCK_UNLOCK canonical token (tokenManager.implementationType()==2, verified on-chain), not a native interchain token. Resolved via InterchainTokenFactory.canonicalInterchainTokenId(mXRP address) and cross-checked with InterchainTokenService.registeredTokenAddress(tokenId) round-tripping back to the mXRP address -- confirmed match on 2026-09-10.

_comment: XRP/USDC XRPL AMM LP token. Address/decimals(15)/tokenId all re-verified live via eth_call on 2026-09-10 (deployment tx already decoded in docs/xrpl-lp-token-bridge-readiness-verification.md). Collateral-only: borrowCap=0, reserveFactor=0 (no interest income). Requires the fallback oracle bot to be live BEFORE activating user traffic -- see docs/07-deployment-configuration.md section 7.

oracle._pricingDeferred: initialFallbackPrice deliberately OMITTED (not placeholdered) -- the field is optional; setFallbackConfig() only needs fallbackMaxDelay to list the market. The LP oracle bot/aggregator setup is deferred per team decision -- see docs/15-xrpl-lp-oracle-bot.md and scripts/runXrplLpOracleBot.ts. Post the real price via oracle.postFallbackPrice() once the bot is live, BEFORE routing any real user traffic to this market (docs/07-deployment-configuration.md section 7). IMPORTANT: whatever value eventually gets posted must be a FLAT $-per-whole-LP-token price at 1e18 precision (matching computePublishedPriceMantissa's output convention) -- SecurdPriceOracle.getUnderlyingPrice applies the underlying-decimals scaling itself now (fixed 2026-09-10), do not pre-scale by this LP token's 15 decimals or the market will be over-valued by 1000x.
